subject: blur
author: TheGaroMan
body: Hey, I was just lookin at this game too in a couple of game magazines and on the web!... it does look pretty cool and im definately gonna get it... theres also another pretty cool lookin racing game comin out in 2010 called Split/Second. you should check that out too  (its got car smashing and explosions.... sounds like a game were all too familiar with...)😎
